records.decision: Declare USB_DP as the positive member of the controlled 90 ohm differential pair.
records.justification: The USB pair contract keeps both nets symmetric and binds routing geometry to the declared stackup.
records.no_alternatives_reason: The fixture exercises the single declared pair.
risks: IPC-2141 is an approximation and requires measured Evidence for authority.

records.decision: Declare USB_DN as the negative member of the controlled 90 ohm differential pair.
records.justification: The USB pair contract keeps both nets symmetric and binds routing geometry to the declared stackup.
records.no_alternatives_reason: The fixture exercises the single declared pair.
risks: IPC-2141 is an approximation and requires measured Evidence for authority.

records.decision: Use a 40 by 35 mm four-layer board with the declared board clearances.
records.justification: The board envelope and four copper layers provide the physical context for the opt-in stackup fixture.
records.no_alternatives_reason: The fixture uses one deterministic board envelope.

records.decision: Use FR-4 dielectric layers and 35 um copper in the four-layer stackup.
records.justification: The layer order and thicknesses make F.Cu to In1.Cu microstrip impedance deterministic.
records.no_alternatives_reason: The fixture uses one deterministic stackup.
assumptions: The dielectric constant is a nominal approximation.
risks: Fabrication variation must be checked by measured Evidence.
